__purpose: 核心概念集合 Es — 用于 Entity Recall (Evaluation_Schema.md §1.4)
__purpose_en: Essential Concepts Set Es — for Entity Recall (Evaluation_Schema.md §1.4)
__source: 从金标准导图 gold_example.json 的节点 label 中提取
__source_en: Extracted from gold standard mind map gold_example.json node labels
__description: 本文件是与 evaluation/data/gold/gold_example.json 配对的核心概念集合。评估 Entity Recall 时，框架使用此列表中的概念检查生成导图是否覆盖了所有关键概念。
__description_en: This file is the essential concepts set paired with evaluation/data/gold/gold_example.json. When evaluating Entity Recall, the framework uses this list to check whether the generated map covers all key concepts.

__format_notes.rule_1: 每个条目应为一个独立的概念术语，不包含标点符号或额外说明
__format_notes.rule_1_en: Each entry should be a standalone concept term, without punctuation or extra explanation
__format_notes.rule_2: 同义词可并列列出（如 SVM 和 Support Vector Machine），框架会自动匹配
__format_notes.rule_2_en: Synonyms can be listed together (e.g., SVM and Support Vector Machine), the framework will auto-match
__format_notes.rule_3: 建议包含中英文双语的术语，以覆盖不同语言的生成导图
__format_notes.rule_3_en: It is recommended to include bilingual terms (Chinese + English) to cover generated maps in different languages
__format_notes.rule_4: 概念总数建议在 10-30 个之间，太少的列表无法有效评估召回率
__format_notes.rule_4_en: Recommended total: 10-30 concepts. Too few will not effectively evaluate recall rate
__format_notes.rule_5: 文件名命名规则：与金标准导图配对的前缀名 + _concepts.json
__format_notes.rule_5_en: File naming: your_gold_prefix_concepts.json (paired with the gold standard map)
